## Checklist

- [ ] I opened or commented on an issue before a change bigger than a fix
- [ ] I wrote the tests first (business logic or bug fix) and `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass, with no warning
- [ ] I updated the documentation that my change makes wrong (README, `docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md` under *Unreleased*)
- [ ] Every text for the user is in `Resources/en.json` **and** `fr.json`
- [ ] No secret, no personal data, no text under copyright, no new dependency without a reason and a compatible license
- [ ] I have read and understood every line I submit (also if an AI tool wrote it)
- [ ] I have signed the [CLA](https://github.com/AntoineYREM/LivingPaper/blob/main/CLA.md) (the bot will ask on a first pull request)
